name: Achievement Item Tracker
description: Searches achievements and tracks required items, displaying your current owned counts across bags, bank, material storage, and shared inventory.

account.details: Required to check API connection and account status.

inventories.details: Required to check item counts in your Bank, Material Storage, and Shared Inventory.

characters.details: Required to check item counts in your character inventories.

progression.details: Required to check your completed achievement progress and collection bits.
